installation.cpu_torch_command: conda run -n ab_optim python -m pip install "torch==2.13.0+cpu" --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu
installation.project_packages_command: conda run -n ab_optim python -m pip install --only-binary=:all: numpy pandas biopython gemmi matplotlib "anarcii==2.0.8"
installation.analysis_packages_command: conda run -n ab_optim python -m pip install --only-binary=:all: scipy scikit-learn statsmodels seaborn pyyaml tqdm pytest

anarcii_smoke.interpretation: Installation acceptance only. The apparent exclusion of the final GS is provisional until the expression construct boundary is confirmed.

regression_tests.command: conda run -n ab_optim python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
